description: AI rich text editor SDK for React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Laravel and vanilla JS
rules: Install with `npm install eddyter` and import 'eddyter/style.css'
Wrap ConfigurableEditorWithAuth in EditorProvider and pass an apiKey from https://eddyter.com/user/license-key
In the Next.js App Router, put the editor in a 'use client' component
